verdict.rationale: Raygun documents source-map decoding. Public source maps are fetched automatically, and when that fails users can upload maps manually through the JS source map center or via an API authenticated with the external access token. That API path could be scripted from CI, but the evidence shows no official CLI or bundler plugin, which is the delivery mechanism the story asks for. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or bundler plugin for source-map upload, CI-specific upload guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that stack traces are de-minified.
